correctness.rationale: The homogeneous derivative equations force exactly the three stated points for d nonzero and none at infinity. The finite geometric singular locus also rules out a reducible or nonreduced projective cubic, since distinct components would intersect in a curve of singularities. At each node the projective tangent cone v²+cyz=0 is smooth even in characteristic two and has a rational point. The blowup is smooth along that conic, and is crepant by the ambient discrepancy 2 minus the hypersurface multiplicity 2; the exceptional conic is a (-2)-curve by adjunction. Projection through a node is birational, and the resolved cubic has nef and big -K with square 3 and geometric Picard rank 7. For xy nonzero, dividing the z-quadratic by (xy)² gives the Artin–Schreier right side (a+b+cab)² with a=1/x, b=1/y. Summing the additive character over b gives the exceptional row a=c⁻¹ and total 1+qε, while the excluded affine axes contribute 2q−1 before the character calculation. Over extensions the trace sign is εⁿ. The triangle at infinity and the three exceptional replacements each add 3qⁿ. The all-extension trace determines the seven Picard eigenvalues (arithmetic/geometric inversion makes no difference to ±1), and inversion and squaring preserve parameter counts. Independently enumerated every affine triple over F₂ through F₆₄, checking all parameters in each subfield and the extension sign explicitly; replay: python3 /workspace/reproductions/frozen_checks.py 2. The finite run does not certify the geometry or all extensions; the proof does.

Identifying the trace sign concretely separates the arithmetic types of a fixed geometric resolution, predicts their behavior over every extension, and gives exact frequencies for both types. The computation is useful beyond the observation that three nodes occur.
